sentences.text: This creature possessed a low skull and a short snout.
Its name translates to "Iharkút crocodile," referencing the specific location of its discovery.
Scientists formally described the genus in 2007.
The type species, I. makadii, honors the researcher László Makádi.
The animal is unusual for having heterodont teeth, with some being complex and multicusped like mammal teeth.
A 2026 study noted Hunter-Schreger band-like patterns and wavy enamel in the teeth, suggesting adaptations for a herbivorous diet and high-efficiency chewing.
Remains were uncovered in the Santonian-aged Csehbánya Formation within the Bakony Mountains of western Hungary.
It lived during the Santonian age, between 85.7 and 83.6 million years ago.
